title: Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: Hearty beef stew with the flavors of Uruguay, inspired by Indian spices. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add onions and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Return beef to pot and reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
